items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I’m recalling Bill Evans with Perry and his brother in the Berkshires, the Lenox School of Jazz, where I studied with Bill and Oscar.

ctx.x: And by that I mean I’d like to start with on your website there’s a recording of “Time Remembered” and —
Yeah. It’s about 7-1/2 minutes and I have a couple of questions about it. As you play it do you know where you’re going from one moment to the next?
